mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_base_member (tenant_id, knowledge_base_id, user_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{userId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM knowledge_base_member WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT kb.id, kb.tenant_id, kb.name FROM knowledge_base kb JOIN knowledge_base_member m ON m.knowledge_base_id = kb.id WHERE kb.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY kb.id
